items.title: Buddy Tate interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard he was. Melvin Moore told me this. Did you know a singer by the name of Melvin Moore? He used to sing with Ernie Fields for a long time, and Don Albert out of San Antonio. And I think he told me that Ernie’s still going, still around, with us.
Tell us about some of your better recordings with the Basie band.
